adimlar: After Fajr prayer: Recite 1 al-Fatihah + Ayat al-Kursi + 3 al-Ikhlas + 1 al-Falaq + 1 an-Nas.
After Maghrib prayer: Repeat the same set. Recite into your palms and wipe them over your entire body.
Before going to bed: Recite Ayat al-Kursi + Amenerresulü (al-Baqarah 285-286).
When leaving home: Recite the supplication «Bismillâhi tevekkeltü alallâh, lâ havle ve lâ kuvvete illâ billâh».

hadis.baslik: Authentic Hadith Supplication — Morning and Evening Shield (Ibn Majah)
hadis.arapca: Bismillâhillezî lâ yedurru me'asmihi şey'ün fil erdı ve lâ fissemâi ve hüves-semî'ul alîm.
hadis.anlam: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm.
hadis.uygulama: Recite 3 times each morning and evening.

b2.not: The suggestions in this section for reciting over water and following a routine fall within permissible ruqyah; they are not direct texts from authentic hadith.
a: Perform wudu and offer 2 rak'ahs of repentance prayer.
Repent sincerely from the heart. Say, «O Allah, I have turned to You; there is no refuge but You.»
b: Take a bottle of clean water. Recite al-Fatihah + Ayat al-Kursi + al-Baqarah 102 + al-A'raf 117-119 + Yunus 81-82 + Ta-Ha 69 + 3 al-Ikhlas + 1 al-Falaq + 1 an-Nas.
Recite each verse 3 or 7 times and blow into the water.
Drink one glass of this water in the morning on an empty stomach, at midday, and before going to bed. Continue for 7 days.
c: Play a recitation of Surah al-Baqarah at home or recite it. A hadith states that Satan does not enter a house where al-Baqarah is recited.
Recite Ayat al-Kursi once after every salah.
Before going to bed, recite 3 al-Ikhlas + 1 al-Falaq + 1 an-Nas, blow into your palms, and wipe them over your entire body.

uyari.mesaj: 🔴 Warning: Going to jinn healers, mediums, and charlatans can lead to shirk. Seek healing from Allah alone!

a: Perform wudu.
Place your right hand on the area you think has been affected by the evil eye.
Say «Bismillah» 3 times.
Recite al-Fatihah 7 times + al-Falaq 7 times + an-Nas 7 times + al-Qalam 51-52 3 times.
With each recitation, blow on the area or apply a little saliva (Sunnah).
Say, «O Allah, grant healing; You are the Healer.»

hadis.baslik: Jibril's (peace be upon him) Ruqyah for the Evil Eye — Muslim, Ibn Majah (Authentic)
hadis.arapca: Bismillâhi erkîke, min kulli şey'in yu'zîke, min şerri kulli nefsin ev ayni hâsidin, Allâhu yeşfîke, bismillâhi erkîke.
hadis.anlam: In the name of Allah, I perform ruqyah for you against everything that troubles you, against the evil of every living being and every envious eye. May Allah grant you healing.
hadis.uygulama: Recite it 7 times over the person you think has been affected by the evil eye.

b: For everything you admire, say, «Maşallah, may Allah protect it from the evil eye.»
Every day, recite 3 al-Ikhlas + 1 al-Falaq + 1 an-Nas over children and blow on them.
Recite the supplication «Bismillâhillezî lâ yedurru...» 3 times each morning and evening.

uyari.mesaj: 🔴 Note: Wearing an evil eye bead and having lead poured are prohibited. Protection comes from Allah alone.

a: Perform wudu and offer 2 rak'ahs of salah.
Recite al-Fatihah 7 times + al-Falaq 7 times + an-Nas 7 times.
Recite into your palms and wipe them over your entire body.
Pray, «O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of those who envy.»
Repeat morning and evening for 7 days.
b: When you see someone else's blessing, say, «Maşallah, may Allah make it a source of good for them.»
When you feel envy, immediately seek Allah's forgiveness.
Pray for the person you envy — this extinguishes the feeling.
Recite Surahs al-Falaq and an-Nas morning and evening.

uyari.mesaj: 🟢 Note (Muslim, Ibn Majah): Jibril's Ruqyah for the Evil Eye is also recited against envy; the same supplication may be repeated 7 times.

a: Immediately say, «Eûzü billâhi mineş-şeytânir-racîm».
Spit lightly to your left 3 times (Sunnah).
Recite verses 97-98 of al-Mu'minun 3 times.
Hold fast to the remembrance «La ilahe illallah».
b: Recite Ayat al-Kursi before going to bed.
Lie on your right side and place your right hand under your cheek.
Recite 3 al-Ikhlas + 1 al-Falaq + 1 an-Nas, blow into your palms, and wipe them over your body.
Pray, «O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self and the evil of Satan.»

uyari.mesaj: ⚠️ Note: Intrusive thoughts are a sign of the presence of iman. Do not dwell on them; seek refuge in Allah and move on.

a: Perform wudu and offer 2 rak'ahs of salah.
Place your right hand on the painful area and say «Bismillah» 3 times.
Recite al-Fatihah 7 times + al-Isra 82 7 times + Yunus 107 7 times.
Recite the supplication «Allâhumme Rabben-nâsi muzhibel-bâsi işfi enteş-Şâfî» 3 times.
Blow on the painful area with each recitation.
Repeat 3 times a day (morning, noon, and evening).

hadis.baslik: Supplication for Pain in a Specific Area — Muslim, Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah (Authentic)
hadis.arapca: Eûzu billâhi ve kudretihî min şerri mâ ecidu ve uhâziru.
hadis.anlam: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of the pain I feel and fear.
hadis.uygulama: Place the right hand on the painful area, and after saying Bismillah 3 times, recite it 7 times.

uyari.mesaj: ⚠️ Warning: Do not neglect to see a doctor. Medical treatment and the Qur'an are not mutually exclusive.

b6.not: The following suggestions for spiritual distress are supportive and do not replace medical or psychological support.
b: Recite al-Fatihah every day while reflecting on its meaning.
Recite 100 times a day: «Lâ ilâhe illâ ente sübhâneke innî küntü minez-zâlimîn» (the supplication of Yunus).
Recite al-Isra 82 over water 7 times and drink it for 7 days.
Frequently seek Allah's forgiveness: «Estağfirullâh» hundreds of times a day.

yap: Recite supplications from the Qur'an yourself — the most reliable source.
Seek healing and protection from Allah alone.
Morning and evening: Ayat al-Kursi + 3 al-Ikhlas + al-Falaq + an-Nas.
For the evil eye: Recite al-Qalam 51-52 and al-Falaq and an-Nas.
When intrusive thoughts come, recite the Eûzü and Besmele: «Eûzü billâhi mineş-şeytânir-racîm. Bismillâhir-rahmânir-rahîm.»
When ill: Use both medical care and the Qur'an together.

yapma.aciklama: Risk of shirk — Attributing protective power to an object is shirk. Alternative: Recite Ayat al-Kursi.
False practice — It has no basis in Islamic sources. Instead: Recite al-Falaq and an-Nas.
Superstition — Attributing metaphysical power to a substance opens the door to shirk.
Major sin — «Whoever goes to a fortune teller and believes them has committed disbelief» (Hadith).
Risk of disbelief — Allah alone knows the unseen.
Risk of shirk / problematic area — Amulets with incomprehensible symbols are rejected. The safest course is to seek refuge in Allah by reciting the verses yourself.
Fraud and haram — Recite over the water yourself; do not obtain it from someone else.
Superstition — Smoke has no power to drive away jinn. Recite the Qur'an.

footer: Awareness of tawhid: Seek healing and protection from Allah alone. Trust in the One who controls the means, not in the means themselves.
